      source.definition = {
  interface: new GlyphFlow.ComponentInterface({
    state: records,
    methods: {
      add: { input: record, output: record,
        handle: (state, row) => ({
          state: [...state, row], result: row
        }) }
    }
  }),
  initial: [], organize
};
await source.api.add(record);
